title: ROS 2 discovery
keywords: discovery discover multicast automatic_discovery_range static_peers daemon no-daemon announce see each other machine machines network
text: Nodes find each other automatically through the middleware; with DDS this uses multicast within the same ROS_DOMAIN_ID. When a node starts it announces itself and learns about the others, and endpoints match when name, type and QoS are compatible. ROS_AUTOMATIC_DISCOVERY_RANGE (SUBNET, LOCALHOST, OFF or SYSTEM_DEFAULT) and ROS_STATIC_PEERS narrow or extend discovery. Discovery takes a moment, and the ros2 CLI daemon can show stale results: add --no-daemon to double-check.
